source_name: TAS Link (ТОВ «ТАС ЛІНК») — banking processing outsourcer
why_relevant: NBU-designated important technological operator of payment services; publishes operator-status disclosures. Indicator of processing outsourcing among TAS-group and third-party banks.

source_name: EasyPay Processing (ТОВ «ЕЙСІ ДІСКІ ПРОЦЕСІНГ»)
why_relevant: Third entity named by the NBU among important payment-infrastructure operators alongside UPC and TAS Link; relevant to self-service terminal and payment-acceptance network coverage.

source_name: Visa Inc. — global newsroom and investor relations (CEMEA / Ukraine country statements)
why_relevant: Visa does not publish Ukraine-level financials, but country press statements, CEMEA commentary and 10-K risk disclosures carry Ukraine market colour; Visa recently overtook Mastercard in UA active-card share.

source_name: Mastercard — investor relations and Ukraine country communications
why_relevant: Same rationale as Visa: no UA segment reporting, but country statements, local Facebook/press channel and group filings provide Ukraine acceptance/issuance context and product launches.

source_name: PSM7.com — Ukrainian payments trade media (payspacemagazine successor)
why_relevant: Specialist payments trade press that decodes NBU terminology, tracks scheme/processor announcements and reports card-market share moves quickly; useful early-warning layer over official releases.

source_name: Finteco / Finance.ua / Forbes.ua payments desks — NBU statistics reporting
why_relevant: These outlets routinely restate NBU payment statistics releases (card counts, POS counts, cashless share, scheme split) with dates, providing a searchable time-series index into official releases that are otherwise hard to fetch.

source_name: Issuer/acquirer bank PROSTIR product pages (e.g. Universal Bank/monobank, A-Bank, PUMB)
why_relevant: Bank-side PROSTIR pages confirm scheme membership, acceptance enablement and product rollouts earlier than the scheme's own participant list; a practical cross-check on scheme penetration.

source_name: Raiffeisen Bank International group disclosures (UPC parent)
why_relevant: UPC has been part of RBI since 2005; group annual reports and segment disclosures are the only audited, English-language window onto the largest Ukrainian processor's ownership and strategic direction.

source_name: ФГВФО — Звіти про діяльність Фонду (DGF annual activity reports + audited financial statements)
why_relevant: Statutorily mandated annual report (Law 'Про систему гарантування вкладів фізичних осіб', art. on reporting to Verkhovna Rada / CMU / NBU by 1 July) bundling a management report, audited IFRS financial statements and a full account of resolution and liquidation activity for the year. This is the single most authoritative annual disclosure covering failed and resolved Ukrainian banks.

source_name: ФГВФО — Архів звітів про діяльність Фонду
why_relevant: Historical back-catalogue of DGF annual reports, giving a multi-year time series of bank failures, payouts and liquidation proceeds back through the 2014-2017 banking clean-up — the period that reshaped the Ukrainian bank/payments market.

source_name: ФГВФО — Статистика (Fund statistics dashboard)
why_relevant: Continuously updated headline indicators: number of DGF member banks, total guaranteed deposits, Fund financial resources, cumulative number of banks that passed under Fund management (111 as observed), and cumulative payouts to depositors of insolvent banks. Gives a quantified market-exit series usable as a denominator for market-sizing.

source_name: ФГВФО — Банки, ліквідовані Фондом (completed liquidations)
why_relevant: Register of banks whose liquidation is finished and which were struck from the Unified State Register — the definitive market-exit event log with dates (e.g. AT 'AKB Konkord' terminated 05.05.2026; AT 'Bank Natsionalni Investytsii' terminated 04.08.2026).

source_name: ФГВФО — Банки, продані інвесторам / продані державі
why_relevant: Records the subset of resolutions that ended in a sale rather than a wind-down — i.e. actual M&A outcomes in Ukrainian banking, including transfers to the state. Directly relevant to who acquired branch networks, card portfolios and acquiring books.

source_name: ФГВФО per-bank liquidation subdomains (*.fg.gov.ua)
why_relevant: Each failed bank gets its own DGF-run portal carrying the disclosures that never exist for healthy banks: financial information of the failed bank, executive-directorate decisions about it, creditor-claim announcements and registers, depositor payout notices, and its asset-sale and property-rental listings. Highly structured and identical across banks, so one scraper covers all entities.

source_name: ФГВФО — Продаж активів (asset sale announcements, direct sale, pools)
why_relevant: Live catalogue of insolvent-bank assets on sale, split by open auctions, direct sale and pooled lots, with categories transport / real estate / credits / other and starting prices in UAH. Reveals what physical estate (including branch premises and IT/POS-relevant equipment) and loan books are leaving failed banks, and at what valuation.

source_name: ФГВФО — Оренда майна банків, що ліквідуються
why_relevant: Rental listings of failed-bank premises. A secondary signal of physical branch estate coming free in specific cities — useful for retail-footprint and network-consolidation analysis.

source_name: ФГВФО — Прес-релізи та новини
why_relevant: The primary event stream for this cell: announcements of banks entering resolution, open competitions to resolve insolvent banks, completion of liquidations, weekly asset-sale volume notices, and periodic aggregate figures on receipts and creditor payouts. Deep archive (pagination observed to page 30+).

source_name: ФГВФО — Врегулювання (виведення з ринку) неплатоспроможних банків / конкурси
why_relevant: The resolution methodology and live deal pipeline: overview of the resolution-preparation procedure, the menu of resolution tools, investor pre-qualification rules, and the conduct of open competitions (e.g. extended competitions for MOTOR-BANK and PIN-BANK, announced Feb 2026). This is where forthcoming market exits and potential acquirers become visible before the outcome.

source_name: ФГВФО — Надходження до банків, що ліквідуються (receipts and creditor-claim settlement)
why_relevant: Periodically refreshed article series reporting cash inflows into banks in liquidation and amounts directed to satisfying creditor claims (e.g. UAH 2,463.4m received and UAH 2.96bn paid to creditors in H1 2026, of which UAH 2,078.9m from asset realisation). The closest thing to a P&L for the failed-bank estate.

source_name: ФГВФО — Реєстр боржників банків, що ліквідуються
why_relevant: Public list of debtors of banks in liquidation. Indirectly maps the corporate counterparty network of failed banks and is a lead source for who owes what to the liquidation estate.

source_name: ФГВФО — Стягнення збитків з ексвласників банків
why_relevant: Dedicated section on damage-recovery litigation against former owners of failed banks. Names the beneficial owners the DGF holds responsible and tracks case progress — a distinctive source of ownership and governance intelligence unavailable from healthy-bank IR.

source_name: ФГВФО — Рішення виконавчої дирекції Фонду (executive directorate decisions)
why_relevant: The legally operative instruments: decisions starting temporary administration, approving resolution plans, beginning and extending liquidation, approving liquidation mass and asset-sale conditions. Also hosts normative acts, martial-law-period decisions and draft-decision consultations — the earliest formal signal of a bank's exit.

source_name: ФГВФО — Перелік звітності для банків-учасників
why_relevant: Defines what reporting DGF member banks must file to the Fund and in what form. A metadata source: it tells you which datasets on healthy and failing banks exist inside the DGF, which in turn defines what can be requested under access-to-public-information.

source_name: Deposit Guarantee Fund of Ukraine — English-language site
why_relevant: English mirror covering resolution of insolvent banks, resolution tools, investor/acquiring-bank pre-qualification, the failed-bank list, statistics, legislation and an English translation of the DGF Law. Useful for cross-checking Ukrainian terminology and for citable English-language framing, though thinner and slower to update than the Ukrainian site.

source_name: Prozorro.Sale — Продаж активів банків-банкрутів (ЦБД1)
why_relevant: The state electronic auction system through which DGF sells insolvent-bank assets; ЦБД1 is the dedicated central database for bankrupt-bank assets. Carries lot-level outcomes (starting price, winning bid, participant counts) that the DGF site only summarises, and it publishes an open-data section. The DGF has an organiser profile page.

source_name: Рахункова палата України — audits and analyses of the Deposit Guarantee Fund
why_relevant: Ukraine's supreme audit institution independently audits DGF activity, the use of Fund resources and the realisation of transferred property — including the risk of non-repayment of UAH 62.5bn of Fund debt to the Ministry of Finance. It supplies critical, non-self-reported assessment of the DGF's liquidation performance and recovery rates, plus follow-up 'information notices' tracking whether the DGF implemented recommendations.

source_name: Національний банк України — insolvency and licence-revocation decisions
why_relevant: The NBU, not the DGF, makes the upstream decision declaring a bank insolvent and revoking its licence, and is legally obliged to publish the full reasoned text of a liquidation decision no later than the day after adoption. This is the trigger event that starts everything the DGF then publishes, and it carries the supervisory reasoning (capital shortfall, AML, related-party lending) absent from DGF material.
